title: [BUG] Empty space on left sidebar
body:
### Willingness to contribute

No. I cannot contribute a bug fix at this time.

### MLflow version

2.7.1

### System information

- Ubuntu 20.04 vscode devcontainer with Windows Chrome web browser:
- Python 3.10.12:



### Describe the problem

Large white empty space on left side of the view:

![image](https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/assets/16224889/a0d54b28-d4c6-4f99-8d77-2519258eeceb)


### Steps to reproduce the bug

- conda install mlflow
- mlflow ui
- open browser to http://localhost:5000

### Code to generate data required to reproduce the bug

_No response_

### Is the console panel in DevTools showing errors relevant to the bug?

No errors

### Does the network panel in DevTools contain failed requests relevant to the bug?

No failed requests

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: @reporter I don't see the empty space on my machine: The command I used: ``` docker run --rm -w /mlflow -v $(pwd)/mlruns:/mlflow/mlruns -p 5000:5000 python:3.8 bash -c 'pip install mlflow && mlflow server --host 0.0.0.0 --gunicorn-opts "--log-level debug"' ``` I'm using a Macbook. It could be a windows-only issue.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
> @reporter Can you try toggling more CSS styles? Is there a CSS style that removes the space?

I had a play around but nothing obvious jumped out to me....but this is where it gets weird (!)

I remoted from my laptop onto my desktop via RDP and the whitespace is gone! So exactly same browser/config is behaving differently when I am logged in locally compared to when I am remoted via RDP.

This has me wondering if there is something odd with font scaling or something similar. My laptop is a Dell XPS 17 with a 4K screen, whilst my desktop is a Samsung 49" UQHD. I am a bit of a loss as to explain whats going on here now :(

I will try to do some more testing w/ my laptop connected directly to the UQHD display and fiddling with the resolutions and scaling settings etc.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
I'm completely stumped :(

I have separate Chrome profiles, one works as normal, one shows the behaviour above (even when in incognito mode). I've been toggling plugins and fiddling with fairly much everything I can think of but nothing seems to stick :~(

I don't think this is a scaling issue (as one profile works and another does not)

Any suggestions on what to try next warmly welcome... but I am guessing this is somehow related to something on my client side rather than an mlflow issue?!
